en: Colorized historic view of a central town square with a large, light-colored town hall building featuring a tall clock tower and ornate gable roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather in the square. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with red roofs, including one signed as a hotel and restaurant. German captions are printed at the top identifying the place as Pirna in Saxon Switzerland and specifying the market square and town hall.
